_doc: All-arenas whitelist for one-seed-many-Nightlords sweeps. Buckets are split by pool-majority for readability; engine treats nb1 and nb2 identically.
_test_note: Sweep complete: 12 confirmed OK_rando arenas. 3 banned for known/predicted phase-transition breakage. Remaining untested (m49_21 DRB, m49_23 Dragonkin, m49_25 Crucible+Hippo, m49_26 Outland Cmdr, m49_29 DHQ) are EMEVD-clean and predicted-safe.

_banned_arenas.m48_20_00_00: Nameless King — Phase 2 transition fails under rando (Storm King death does not trigger NK foot-form spawn). Confirmed BROKEN.
_banned_arenas.m48_30_00_00: Dancer — EMEVD has CharacterHasSpEffect + SetSpEffect + CreateReferredDamagePair + WarpCharacterAndCopyFloor patterns. Predicted to fail similarly to Nameless King (chr-internal phase logic not satisfied by swap targets).
_banned_arenas.m48_40_00_00: Morgott — EMEVD has CreateReferredDamagePair patterns suggesting phase 2 (Cursed Mark / black holy spear) transition logic. Banned conservatively pending direct test.
_banned_arenas.m49_26_00_00: Outland Commander — banned by user preference. Commander variants share c3050 c_prefix with Battlefield Commander; conservative ban pending future investigation.
_banned_arenas.m49_27_00_00: Battlefield Commander — banned by user preference. Commander variants share c3050 c_prefix; conservative ban pending future investigation.
